title: Hackers Had a Live Feed of Every ID Verification Company Scanned for over a Year
summary: A major security breach occurred where hackers maintained unauthorized access to a live feed of identity verification scans from a verification company for over a year, exposing sensitive personal data of countless users to potential misuse.
problem_solved: Highlights the critical vulnerability in identity verification data pipelines and raises awareness about the need for robust security monitoring.
why_valuable: Serves as a cautionary case study on the dangers of prolonged undetected access to sensitive identity data, emphasizing the importance of continuous security auditing and anomaly detection.
